distractors.description: You might think that using str.length() will give you the last character because it seems logical to use the length of the string to access the last element. However, this is a common off-by-one error. In Java, string indexing is zero-based, meaning the first character is at index 0, and the last character is at index str.length() - 1. Using str.length() directly will result in an IndexOutOfBoundsException because it tries to access an index that is one past the last valid index. Remember, the length of the string is not a valid index.
